disclaimer.title: App Disclaimer & Privacy Policy
disclaimer.paragraph: This application is an independent public utility created for general educational, reference, and informational purposes. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by any government entity or department. While utmost care is taken to ensure data accuracy, users are advised to verify critical information through official portals.
